purpose: Read-only template for future durable routing smoke gates before dry-run or adoption exercises.

field_descriptions.target_repository: Repository root that owns source, OpenSpec artifacts, and repo-local durable state for the exercise.
field_descriptions.phase: Project phase that drives routing thresholds, such as read-context, verify-accept, execute-parallel, integrate-converge, or stabilize.
field_descriptions.task: Concrete work item or validation question evaluated by the routing plan.
field_descriptions.operator_consent_boundary: Explicit boundary between read-only planning and mutating actions such as -Apply, .omx/state writes, or durable-team launch.
field_descriptions.routing_mode: Whether the future exercise is read-only, dry-run, or explicitly apply-capable.
field_descriptions.mutation_allowed: Boolean consent flag; default is false and may become true only through reviewed change plus explicit operator consent.
field_descriptions.validation_path: Commands, checks, or evidence required to prove the future exercise result.
field_descriptions.rollback_path: Recovery steps if a future exercise is misconfigured or must be reverted.

read_only_guards: Do not run omx-team-auto.ps1 -Apply from the template checker.
Do not launch native_omx or LangGraph from the template checker.
Do not write .omx/state from the template checker.
